_doc: The apps this tree transpiles and links, in dependency order. An app is BC's unit of deployment, version and dependency, and it becomes one library under apps/ so that the LINKER enforces the direction AL declares: the Base Application may not know an extension, only the other way round and only through events. `source` is read under the BCApps `src` root; `depends` names apps that must already be linked. A TEST APP IS A NORMAL APP -- its codeunits are AL like any other, it depends on what it tests, and it is compiled like everything else. That is what makes a full run of the suite affordable, and an affordable full run is what makes its number mean anything.
